mapper.sql: WHERE decision_point_id = #{pointId} AND rule_set_code = #{code} AND version_no <= #{maxVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT rule_set_version_id FROM t_rule_set_version ORDER BY version_no DESC, rule_set_version_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: FROM t_decision_release dr JOIN t_decision_point_version pv ON pv.point_version_id = dr.point_version_id JOIN t_decision_point dp ON dp.decision_point_id = pv.decision_point_id JOIN t_decision_point_rule_set b ON b.point_version_id = pv.point_version_id JOIN t_rule_set_version rv ON rv.rule_set_version_id = b.rule_set_version_id JOIN t_rule_set rs ON rs.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id AND rs.rule_set_code = rv.rule_set_code

dr.release_id, dr.release_no, dr.environment_code, dr.status, dp.point_code, pv.point_version_id, pv.version_no AS point_version_no, rv.rule_set_version_id, rv.version_no, dr.activated_time, dr.superseded_time
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ORDER BY dr.release_id DESC, rv.rule_set_version_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_decision_release dr LEFT JOIN t_decision_point_version pv ON pv.point_version_id = dr.point_version_id LEFT JOIN t_decision_point_rule_set b ON b.point_version_id = dr.point_version_id LEFT JOIN t_rule_set_version rv ON rv.rule_set_version_id = b.rule_set_version_id LEFT JOIN t_rule_set rs ON rs.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id AND rs.rule_set_code = rv.rule_set_code WHERE dr.decision_flow_version_id IS NULL AND (dr.decision_point_id = #{pointId} OR rv.decision_point_id = #{pointId}) AND (pv.point_version_id IS NULL OR b.binding_id IS NULL OR rv.rule_set_version_id IS NULL OR rs.rule_set_id IS NULL OR dr.decision_point_id != pv.decision_point_id OR dr.decision_point_id != rv.decision_point_id OR pv.status != 'FROZEN' OR rv.status != 'FROZEN' OR dr.environment_code NOT IN ('TEST', 'PRODUCTION') OR dr.status NOT IN ('DRAFT','VALIDATING','SHADOWING','REVIEW_PENDING','APPROVED','ACTIVE','SUPERSEDED','REJECTED') OR (dr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (dr.active_slot IS NULL OR dr.active_slot != 1 OR rs.status != 'CONFIGURABLE')) OR (dr.status != 'ACTIVE' AND dr.active_slot IS NOT NULL))
SELECT DISTINCT WHERE dr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND dr.active_slot = 1 AND rv.rule_set_version_id IN #{id} ORDER BY dr.release_id DESC, rv.rule_set_version_id DESC
mapper.sql:
FROM t_risk_rule rr JOIN t_rule_set_version rv ON rv.rule_set_version_id = rr.rule_set_version_id JOIN t_rule_set rs ON rs.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id AND rs.rule_set_code = rv.rule_set_code JOIN t_decision_point dp ON dp.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id JOIN t_rule_action ra ON ra.rule_id = rr.rule_id JOIN t_action_version av ON av.action_version_id = ra.action_version_id
JOIN t_rule_action_parameter rap ON rap.rule_action_id = ra.rule_action_id JOIN t_action_parameter_definition apd ON apd.parameter_definition_id = rap.parameter_definition_id AND apd.action_version_id = ra.action_version_id

choose.otherwise: av.action_code = 'ADD_RISK_TAG' AND av.terminal_flag = 0 AND apd.parameter_code = 'TAG' AND apd.value_type = 'STRING' AND rap.source_type = 'LITERAL' AND rap.string_value = #{code} AND rap.feature_version_id IS NULL AND rap.field_code IS NULL AND rap.number_value IS NULL AND rap.boolean_value IS NULL AND rap.datetime_value IS NULL AND rap.duration_value IS NULL

mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT rr.rule_id, rs.rule_set_id, dp.point_code, rv.rule_set_code, rv.rule_set_name, rv.rule_set_version_id, rv.version_no, rr.rule_code, rr.rule_name, rs.status AS rule_set_status, (rs.current_rule_set_version_id = rv.rule_set_version_id) AS is_current_configuration, ra.sequence_no AS action_sequence_no, ra.target_binding_code NULL AS action_sequence_no, NULL AS target_binding_code
ORDER BY rv.rule_set_version_id DESC, rr.rule_id, action_sequence_no LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT rr.rule_id AS source_row_id, 'RULE_SET' AS source_type, dp.point_code, rs.rule_set_id, rv.rule_set_code, rv.rule_set_name, rv.rule_set_version_id, rv.version_no, rr.rule_code, rr.rule_name, rs.status AS rule_set_status, (rs.current_rule_set_version_id = rv.rule_set_version_id) AS is_current_configuration, NULL AS flow_id, NULL AS flow_code, NULL AS flow_name, NULL AS flow_version_id, NULL AS flow_version_no, NULL AS node_key, NULL AS node_name, NULL AS flow_status, rv.rule_set_version_id AS source_version_id, rs.status AS source_status FROM t_risk_rule rr JOIN t_rule_set_version rv ON rv.rule_set_version_id = rr.rule_set_version_id JOIN t_rule_set rs ON rs.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id AND rs.rule_set_code = rv.rule_set_code JOIN t_decision_point dp ON dp.decision_point_id = rv.decision_point_id JOIN t_rule_action ra ON ra.rule_id = rr.rule_id JOIN t_action_version av ON av.action_version_id = ra.action_version_id WHERE rr.reason_code = #{code} AND av.terminal_flag = 1 AND av.decision_code = 'DENY' UNION ALL SELECT n.node_id, 'FLOW_END', dp.point_code, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, (f.current_flow_version_id = v.flow_version_id), f.flow_id, f.flow_code, v.flow_name, v.flow_version_id, v.version_no, n.node_key, n.node_name, f.status, v.flow_version_id, f.status FROM t_decision_flow_node n JOIN t_decision_flow_version v ON v.flow_version_id = n.flow_version_id JOIN t_decision_flow f ON f.flow_id = v.flow_id JOIN t_decision_point dp ON dp.decision_point_id = f.decision_point_id WHERE n.reason_code = #{code} AND n.node_type = 'END' AND n.decision_code = 'DENY'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () r ORDER BY source_version_id DESC, source_type, source_row_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
